rules.tag6: usage kind=raw>>29 must be6; methodSpecIndex=(raw&0x1fffffff)>>1 on v31.
rules.method_spec: Native registration.methodSpecs + index*12; <iii = methodDefinitionIndex,classInstantiationIndex,methodInstantiationIndex. -1 means no context.
rules.generic_inst: genericInsts is an array of pointers; selected pointer targets two native-sized UInt64 fields on PE32+: type_argc and type_argv. type_argv points to type_argc Il2CppType pointers.
rules.argument_type: Il2CppType has native-sized data at+0, uint32 bits at+8. typeEnum=(bits>>16)&0xff. For enumCLASS0x12/VALUETYPE0x11, data is the original metadata type-definition index. Other kinds remain explicit unknowns here.

get_component_return_abi.evidence_type: Original PE machine-code bytes decoded with installed Iced; bounded helper instruction observation
limitations: This observes static register/stack instructions, not a live component value.
Whether GetComponentFastPath populates the pointed stack storage is established by its contract/native implementation; this helper observation alone does not record its execution.
The decompiled constant return must be assessed against the actual final RAX load and stack-address setup preserved here.

return_value_observation.conclusion: The machine code reloads RAX from [RSP+0x20] after GetComponentFastPath and then returns. A decompiled unconditional return 0 is not faithful to this explicit return-value load.
return_value_observation.unknown: The actual runtime value in that stack slot and the callee write relative to the R8=[RSP+0x28] argument are not observed by this static helper decoding.
